title: Sebastian and the Will
author: Hazel Whitlock
blurb: Rosalind Ravensworth, a true-crime podcaster chasing the coldest case on record, thought they had seen every way a life can end. But when the missing person's diary continues past the date she disappeared, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must close the one case everyone swore was closed for good before the tide gives up what it took.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
